content: In the opening inquiry of section 3 (the spoken form), Ibn Turka says only the written form remains imprinted on the pages of time across the ages, whereas the spoken form encompasses every mode of expression, rational and irrational, of man and animal. The final level of descent from existential oneness is the oneness of genus, terminating in the low genus, its fifth stage, schematized in the Ṭahawī Circle.
